integrity: Complete all-size algebraic proof; direct exact binary matrix verification in checker.py. The full published single-bond and 3D cancellation proofs were compared to the new two-bond statement; historical priority remains provisional; no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Pure qubit graph states only; square even-circumference periodic grids; exactly zero, one, or two omitted gates; fixed checkerboard cut. No noise robustness, larger gate-deletion sets, other bipartitions or quantum advantage asserted.
title: Two-bond noncancellation on square toroidal cluster states
